mapper.select: SELECT quota_timezone, pending_quota_timezone, quota_period_start, quota_period_end FROM enterprise WHERE id = #{enterprise} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_bucket (id, enterprise_id, policy_id, period_start, period_end, timezone, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{value}, #{enterprise}, #{id}, #{time}, #{time2}, #{timezone}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = quota_bucket.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, used_count, reserved_count FROM quota_bucket WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND policy_id = #{id} AND period_start = #{time} FOR UPDATE
SELECT bucket_id, state FROM quota_entry WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND run_id = #{run} ORDER BY bucket_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_entry (enterprise_id, run_id, bucket_id, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{enterprise}, #{run}, #{bucket}, 'reserved', #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'reserved', updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
